name: Research in Visual Science
notes: Five courses. NEEDS VERIFICATION: the department page names only the foundation course and the two research semesters, then states a five-course total without saying what the other two are.
The two research semesters may be with the same CVS faculty member or with two different faculty.

requirementGroups.label: One foundation course
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: Research Minor in Visual Science. Five courses are required. One of the following: CVSC/BCSC 110: Neural Foundations of Behavior; CVSC/BCSC 111: Foundations of Cognitive Science; CVSC/BCSC 151: Perception & Action; OPT 248/448: Vision and the Eye

requirementGroups.label: Two semesters of independent research in visual science
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: Two semesters of CVSC/BCSC 395: Independent Research in Visual Science. These may be either with the same faculty member in CVS or with two different faculty.
requirementGroups.note: TWO SEMESTERS of the same course. The planner counts distinct course codes, so the CVSC and BCSC cross-listings stand in for the two semesters; in practice you register for CVSC 395 twice.

requirementGroups.label: Two further visual-science courses
requirementGroups.note: NEEDS VERIFICATION: the page states a five-course total but names only three of them.
